calculation.description: Ranks assets by the negative of their recent 10-day return, scaled by 20-day daily-return volatility. The stored signal is reversal-oriented; validation found negative IC, so a consumer seeking positive expected returns should use direction=-1 (equivalent to volatility-scaled recent momentum). All inputs are observable at the decision cutoff.

validation.period: available aligned history through 2029-11-15; 852 valid cross-sectional dates
validation.regime_notes: The reversal-oriented signal was negative overall, with 10-day IC -0.032329 and ICIR -1.7300; use consumer direction=-1 for momentum orientation. Regime diagnostics for the available aligned sample showed 2025 IC +0.041614, 2027-2028 IC -0.090052, and 2029 YTD IC +0.041614 as reported by the research run; interpret regime dependence conservatively given the 15-asset cross-section.
validation.admission: PASS by absolute daily paper IC and absolute daily paper ICIR gates; sign must be explicitly retained in consumer metadata.
